panel.says: one row per entity per period: every ("entity", "year") pair in this table is unique, so rowCount (41) counts readings, never subjects — there are 41 of those
panel.decidedBy: every ("entity", "year") pair is unique across all 41 rows, and "entity" holds no blank

coverage.says: a period's own step being present is not the same as every entity being present in it: the fullest period here carries 41 entities and the thinnest carries 41

aggregates.says: an aggregate here is a row of this table that is the SUM of other rows of the same table. byArithmetic is DECIDED from the numbers: the same set of rows adds up to it in every period. byStructure is a proposal and nothing more — a row whose code is shaped unlike the rest of the column, or missing from it — and it also sweeps in places whose code is merely unusual. Take a proposal as a question to put to the journalist, never as an answer.

arithmetic.reason: this table carries 1 period, and a set of rows that adds up once is a coincidence rather than an aggregate — see AGGREGATE_MIN_PERIODS

statedIncompleteness.says: the frozen prose states no incompleteness in English and French; a dataset that states one in another language is not read here
